topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design significantly impacts encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Phased arrays and reconfigurable antennas enhance signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) through adaptive beamforming, reducing interference. Lower polarization correlation coefficients improve diversity, aiding consistent signal processing.
reference_context: SatCom systems utilize machine learning for internet traffic classification, with antenna design affecting signal quality and classification accuracy.
